subject: PO number decomposition and temporary cap request
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Flynn <purchasing@avasupplies.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: PO number decomposition + spend cap issue

Hi Rebecca / Ava team —

Quick note from procurement: when we attempted to onboard the first invoice you sent, the tax and shipping lines were mapped to the same SKU bucket as the hardware line, which pushed the single-line PO over the assigned spend cap. That blocked auto-issuance of a single consolidated PO number in our provisioning system.

To keep onboarding moving, we need either: (A) a decomposed PO with two distinct line items (hardware + services/tax/shipping), each within the spend cap; or (B) a temporary provisional PO number and an internal cap-exception so we can bill the initial order while procurement coordinates the final split.

Can you attach a version of your invoice with explicit line-item breakdown and indicate which rows are taxable/shipment so we can map them correctly? I attached the onboarding form for reference — please fill the "line_item_notes" section if possible.

Next steps I propose:
- Rebecca: send corrected line-item spreadsheet (separate rows for hardware vs. services)
- Priyom: once received, we draft a provisional PO number and open a cap-exception (if needed)
- Laura: finance sign-off for any temporary cap increase

I'll keep this thread focused on the intake documents so the Jira ticket (PROC-8432) can track the work.

Thanks,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Vendor Onboarding, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com

Attachment: Ava_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Rebecca Flynn <purchasing@avasupplies.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya_Sales <sales@avasupplies.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO number decomposition + spend cap issue

Hi Connor — thanks for the heads up. Apologies for the consolidated invoice — we typically submit a single invoice but can provide a line-level split.

I've attached a corrected spreadsheet that separates the hardware (Model X units) from professional services, taxes, and shipping. The taxable rows are flagged in column D and there's a short "mapping_hint" column for your procurement system.

Attachment: Ava_lineitems_corrected.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

If you need us to produce two distinct invoices instead of one split invoice, we can do that too, but we'd prefer the PO decomposition if possible to avoid multiple invoice submissions. Tell us which PO number to reference once it's issued.

Best,
Rebecca Flynn
VP Operations, Ava Supplies Inc.
rebecca@avasupplies.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO number decomposition + spend cap issue

Connor / Priyom —

Thanks for flagging. Finance can approve a one-time provisional PO (temp PO) for this initial invoice while procurement finalizes the split, provided we have:
1) Vendor-signed breakdown (received from Rebecca)
2) A clear plan to reclassify lines and reissue a final PO within 30 days
3) A cap-exception request submitted via DocuSign with business justification (nr: "one-time onboarding — tax mapping issue").

I cannot approve a permanent cap raise without a spend forecast from vendor and product owner, but a provisional PO is fine. Priyom — can you draft the provisional PO using the attached template and attach the DocuSign exception so I can sign?

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: Procurement_temp_po_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO number decomposition + spend cap issue

On Mon, Jun 22, 2026 at 08:17 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Connor / Priyom —
> 
> Thanks for flagging. Finance can approve a one-time provisional PO (temp PO) for this initial invoice while procurement finalizes the split...
>
Thanks Laura — I'll take this. Connor, I'll prepare a provisional PO using the attached template and set the ledger mapping so hardware sits under SKU 7001 and services/tax/shipping under SKU 7002 once you confirm the mapping_hint column in Rebecca's spreadsheet.

Plan:
- I will create PROC-8432 in Jira and link the DocuSign exception.
- Issue provisional PO: RED-PO-2026-0743 (provisional) — will be visible to vendor in our portal but flagged as provisional.
- Within 10 business days we'll reissue final PO numbers: RED-PO-2026-0743-1 (hardware) and RED-PO-2026-0743-2 (services/tax).

Connor — can you confirm the exact mapping rows in the attached spreadsheet today so I can issue the provisional PO this afternoon?

Thanks,
Priyom
Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Rebecca Flynn <purchasing@avasupplies.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 13:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO number decomposition + spend cap issue

Thanks Priyom — that's perfect. I've added a short "procurement_notes" column in the spreadsheet that matches your SKU suggestion: 7001 = hardware, 7002 = services/shipping/tax.

We prefer the reissued final PO numbers approach (single provisional followed by two finals). We'll accept RED-PO-2026-0743 as provisional and will wait for RED-PO-2026-0743-1 / -2 for closing invoices.

One ask: can you confirm that the provisional PO will allow our initial invoice to be paid on the upcoming accounts-payable run (cutoff Thu 25 Jun)? If not, we'll submit split invoices immediately.

Rebecca

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Flynn <purchasing@avasupplies.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO number decomposition + spend cap issue

Folks — quick update and confirmation.

- Priyom has created the provisional PO RED-PO-2026-0743 (procurement portal link: https://portal.redwood.com/po/RED-PO-2026-0743) and linked Jira PROC-8432.
- Laura, thanks for agreeing to the provisional cap via DocuSign (exception submitted: https://docusign.com/link/abc-ponum-exception).
- Rebecca, I confirm the mapping in Ava_lineitems_corrected.xlsx (7001 = hardware, 7002 = services/tax/shipping).
- Finance confirmed provisional PO is eligible for the Thu 25 Jun AP run provided the vendor supplies the corrected invoice referencing RED-PO-2026-0743. If payment timing becomes an issue, vendor to inform us and we'll arrange an interim split invoice.

Next steps (owner):
- Rebecca: upload corrected invoice referencing RED-PO-2026-0743 (external) — by Wed 23 Jun EOD
- Priyom: reissue final POs RED-PO-2026-0743-1 and -2 within 10 business days post payment
- Connor: close PROC-8432 once both final POs are issued and invoices reconciled

Thanks all — moving to action.

Connor O'Brien
Vendor Onboarding, Redwood Inference
